chapter: Jack Carey's band and piano players
title: Jack Carey's death and his band members
summary: They discuss what happened to Jack Carey, his daughter Evelyn, and who was in the band that left him to form their own.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, what happened to Jack Carey? He just killed, he died. He died a natural death?
Well, I don't know if he died. I don't know.
Oh, that's right. I just wanted, I heard some things. I think he just died.

He got a daughter yet, I ain't still a yet. I mean, Evelyn Carey. Evelyn Carey. Yeah, I know she married. I thought she married. I don't know what part of the time she lived in. I sure would like to see her. She was a little kid when I lived.
Who was, who would know? Somebody must have in the band probably kept up with it. Who's still there? Jack Carey.
Well, that's the trouble. Who was in the band that time? Chester. He's here. Myself. Johnny was with us a while.

I think that's all. Who was the band? George Boyd. That's kind of one. See, that's how we left Jack. Them black guys pushed me up, you know, to get up our own band. That's how we left Jack. We're all left together. Walter Prustin, George Boyd, Chester's artist, Lil' Chinese, and myself. You see, them times, no saxophone.
